Vil private per shitje ne kombinat pran shkolles Shyqeri Peza 
 Vila eshte e perber nga 3 kate ku ndahet ne 3 apartament kati 2 edhe i 3 ndahen ne 2+1 ndersa kati 1 ose perdhes eshte i ndar ne 1+1 
 Kati perdhes ka siperfaqe 55.9m2 
 Kati 2 ka siperfaqe 93.6 m2 
 Kati 3 ka siperfaqe 95.3 m2 
 Siperfaqe trruall 155.8 m2 
 Shitet e mobiluar 
 Papafingo e shfrytzueshme
description_en: Private villa for sale in the complex near the Shyqeri Peza school. The villa consists of 3 floors, divided into 3 apartments. The 2nd and 3rd floors are divided into 2+1, while the 1st or ground floor is divided into 1+1. The ground floor has an area of 55.9m2. The 2nd floor has an area of 93.6 m2. 155.8 m2 for sale, furnished, usable attic
